newsitem.title: JAPAN: Pacific Century says bullish on Japan land market.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Century says bullish on Japan land market.

text.p: Pacific Century Group chairman Richard Li said on Thursday that he was generally bullish about commercial and residential land prices in Japan, but added price levels had not bottomed out yet.
Li said that while generally bullish about both commercial and residential real estate in Japan, he was more confident about the prime areas.
"I have to say that my faith is much more in the triple A areas," he said.
Asked if he was considering any more projects on the scale of his last Tokyo land purchase, he said, "When the right opportunity comes and if is triple A or at least double A, I would be attracted."
But he said he would shy away from small lower grade properties even if they had high yields.

Asked about the government's announcement of measures to turn collateralised land into securities, Li said he welcomed the move but wanted to see the first few transactions went smoothly before he could feel more confident about the scheme.
